title: Food-Food Production Metagenome
description: This bioproject spans multiple research efforts within the FDA foods program (FDA-CFSAN, FDA-ORA, and FDA-CVM) whose main focus is the characterization of metagenomes originating from the food production setting. These efforts include characterizing food and food production environment microbiomes, antimicrobial resistance in foods, and identifying human pathogens in this setting and their transmission across the farm to fork continuum.
